resources.string: Use this tablet as a photo frame
Make kinframe the tablet’s home app. It then starts by itself when the tablet turns on, and the Home button always brings you back to the photos.
Pick kinframe in the list and confirm it as the default.
A photo frame is on all day, so leave the charger connected. At night the sleep schedule you set in the app darkens the screen.
kinframe is not this tablet’s home app yet, so it does not start by itself when the tablet turns on.
This frame gets its updates from Google Play.
An update is ready. Follow the steps from Google Play to install it.
